definition: Jan Leike is the co-inventor of RLHF and Alignment Lead at Anthropic (formerly OpenAI).
details: Co-authored the foundational Deep RL from Human Preferences paper, co-led OpenAI's Superalignment team, and leads alignment science at Anthropic. Jan Leike (born 1986 or 1987) is an AI alignment researcher who has worked at DeepMind and OpenAI. He joined Anthropic in May 2024.

explainer.lead: Jan Leike is an AI alignment researcher. His work spans AI safety.

timeline.what: Doctor of Philosophy, Australian National University
